title: San Francisco Art Institute found pay errors for 22 of 90 work-study students

beats.text: A payroll check at San Francisco Art Institute reached every work-study student.

visual.sub: An earlier reimbursement error put $33 back into work-study

beats.text: An earlier audit documented a $33 refund to the federal program.

visual.kicker: An earlier reimbursement error put $33 back into work-study

beats.text: Federal rules required paid hours to match each student’s time sheet.
In the next audit, a student had worked six hours.

visual.kicker: Six hours worked, five hours paid

beats.text: The school paid for five. The missing hour was worth $12.25.
The student received that money, and auditors verified the payment.

visual.kicker: Six hours worked, five hours paid

beats.text: The Education Department then required a review covering an entire year.

visual.kicker: A federal review requirement extended the check to all 90 recipients

beats.text: Of 90 work-study students, 22 received the wrong pay.
Seven received too little. Fifteen received too much.

visual.kicker: A federal review requirement extended the check to all 90 recipients

beats.text: The seven underpaid students received $460 in all.

visual.kicker: Seven students received $460 and the program received $659

beats.text: The federal work-study program received $659 for the overpayments.
The following signed audit listed the payroll finding as corrected.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
